verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf gbi se chiri oma rọye vwẹ irharo rẹ ihwo ri mudia kẹrẹ-ẹ; ọ da van, E ji kohwo kohwo bi nu vwe oma. Ọtiọye na ohwo ọvuọvo rhe mudia kẹrẹ Josẹf ọke rọ vwọ vwẹ oma phia kẹ emesẹ rọye-e.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef gbi se chiri oma roye vwe irharo re ihwo ri mudia kere e o da van e ji kohwo kohwo bi nu vwe oma otioye na ohwo ovuovo rhe mudia kere josef oke ro vwo vwe oma phia ke emese roye e

verses.text_urhobo: O da viẹ phia, ihwo rẹ Ijipt na de nyo, ekru ri Fero ejobi de ji nyo.
verses.text_romanized: o da vie phia ihwo re ijipt na de nyo ekru ri fero ejobi de ji nyo

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da ta kẹ emesẹ rọye, Mẹvwẹ Josẹf, ọsẹ Me je akpọ? Ẹkẹvuọvo emesẹ rọye gbe sa kpahe kẹ-ẹ, kidie ofu dje ayen hwe vwẹ obaro rọye.
verses.text_romanized: josef da ta ke emese roye mevwe josef ose me je akpo ekevuovo emese roye gbe sa kpahe ke e kidie ofu dje ayen hwe vwe obaro roye

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf da ta kẹ emesẹ rọye, We si kẹrẹ ovwẹ, Me rẹ ovwan. Ayen de si kẹrẹ. Ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Josẹf rẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ ovwan, rẹ ovwan shẹ kpo Ijipt.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da ta ke emese roye we si kere ovwe me re ovwan ayen de si kere o da ta mevwe josef re omose re ovwan re ovwan she kpo ijipt

verses.text_urhobo: We jẹn oma ro ovwa-an, eyẹ we jẹn ivun rẹ oma rẹ ovwan miovwo ovwa-an, fikiridie wa shẹ vwẹ rhe obonẹ, kidie Ọghẹnẹ ji vwe ka obaro re vwo sivwi arhọ.
verses.text_romanized: we jen oma ro ovwa an eye we jen ivun re oma re ovwan miovwo ovwa an fikiridie wa she vwe rhe obone kidie oghene ji vwe ka obaro re vwo sivwi arho

verses.text_urhobo: Kidie owẹvwe na firi vwẹ otọ na ikpe ivẹ nana re; ikpe iyori ji chekọ rẹ ihwo de je voro eyẹ evuo.
verses.text_romanized: kidie owevwe na firi vwe oto na ikpe ive nana re ikpe iyori ji cheko re ihwo de je voro eye evuo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ ko ji vwe ka obaro rere e vwo sivwi umuku rẹ ihwo vwẹ akpọ na, rere ihwo rẹ ovwan buebu vwọ sa rhọ.
verses.text_romanized: oghene ko ji vwe ka obaro rere e vwo sivwi umuku re ihwo vwe akpo na rere ihwo re ovwan buebu vwo sa rho

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye na ọ gbe dianẹ ovwan ri ji vwe rhe obonẹ-ẹ, ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ; ọ da vwẹ ovwẹ ru ọsẹ ki Fero, kugbe olori rẹ uwevwi rọye ejobi vẹ osun rẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: otioye na o gbe diane ovwan ri ji vwe rhe obone e ekevuovo oghene o da vwe ovwe ru ose ki fero kugbe olori re uwevwi roye ejobi ve osun re oto re ijipt ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Jọphẹre yan bru ọsẹ mẹ re wa ta kẹ, Enẹ Josẹf rẹ ọmọ wẹn tare, Ọghẹnẹ vwẹ ovwẹ ru olori rẹ Ijipt ejobi; yan bru vwe rhe, wo gbe eghẹrẹ-ẹ,
verses.text_romanized: jophere yan bru ose me re wa ta ke ene josef re omo wen tare oghene vwe ovwe ru olori re ijipt ejobi yan bru vwe rhe wo gbe eghere e

verses.text_urhobo: wọ cha dia otọ ri Goshẹn, ku wo si kẹrẹ ovwẹ, re owẹ te emọ wẹn kugbe emọ wẹn vẹ emọ rayen, te igodẹ wẹn, vẹ uchuru wẹn, kugbe obo wo vwori ejobi,
verses.text_romanized: wo cha dia oto ri goshen ku wo si kere ovwe re owe te emo wen kugbe emo wen ve emo rayen te igode wen ve uchuru wen kugbe obo wo vwori ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: kẹ Etiyin Me da ghẹre owẹ, kidie ikpe iyori soso rẹ owẹvwe na ji chekọ, ọ rha dia eriyi-in te owẹ te evwruwevwi wẹn ejobi, kugbe obo wo vwori ejobi da rhe kpẹn abọ rẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ke etiyin me da ghere owe kidie ikpe iyori soso re owevwe na ji cheko o rha dia eriyi in te owe te evwruwevwi wen ejobi kugbe obo wo vwori ejobi da rhe kpen abo re

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ enẹna ẹro wẹn mrẹre, ẹro rẹ oniọvo mẹ Bẹnjamin je mrẹre, tanẹ unu mẹ re ta ota na kẹ wẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: vwe enena ero wen mrere ero re oniovo me benjamin je mrere tane unu me re ta ota na ke we na

verses.text_urhobo: Wo mi gbe ikun rẹ erhuvwu mẹ re wọ mrẹre vwẹ Ijipt na kẹ ọsẹ mẹ, kugbe obo wọ mrẹre ejobi. Jọphẹre reyọ ọsẹ Me rhe obonẹ.
verses.text_romanized: wo mi gbe ikun re erhuvwu me re wo mrere vwe ijipt na ke ose me kugbe obo wo mrere ejobi jophere reyo ose me rhe obone

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da gbanọ Bẹnjamin rẹ oniọvo rọye na ohọre ọ da viẹ, Bẹnjamin da je viẹ vwẹ ohọre rọye.
verses.text_romanized: o da gbano benjamin re oniovo roye na ohore o da vie benjamin da je vie vwe ohore roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da fiọnfiọn emesẹ rọye ejobi unu ọ da viẹ ku ayen; rẹ ena ejobi vwọ wan nu emesẹ rọye ejobi de nene gbe ikun.
verses.text_romanized: o da fionfion emese roye ejobi unu o da vie ku ayen re ena ejobi vwo wan nu emese roye ejobi de nene gbe ikun

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ usi rẹ ikun na vwo te uwevwi ri Fero, nẹ, Emesẹ ri Josẹf rhere, oma da vwerhe Fero vẹ idibo rọye gangan.
verses.text_romanized: re usi re ikun na vwo te uwevwi ri fero ne emese ri josef rhere oma da vwerhe fero ve idibo roye gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Ta kẹ emesẹ wẹn, Ru Ọnana kru eghwa kpahe eranvwe wẹn re we rhivwi kpo otọ ri Kenan,
verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ki josef ta ke emese wen ru onana kru eghwa kpahe eranvwe wen re we rhivwi kpo oto ri kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Reyọ ọsẹ wẹn kugbe evwruwevwi wẹn, re we bru vwe rhe, ke Me vwẹ otọ esiri rẹ Ijipt na vwọ kẹ wẹ, ku wọ re ivwri rẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: reyo ose wen kugbe evwruwevwi wen re we bru vwe rhe ke me vwe oto esiri re ijipt na vwo ke we ku wo re ivwri re oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Mi ji ji urhi, Ru Ọnana reyọ akpẹrẹ nẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt yanran re vwo mu imitete na vẹ eya wẹn, ji mu ọsẹ wẹn, ru wọ rhe.
verses.text_romanized: mi ji ji urhi ru onana reyo akpere ne oto re ijipt yanran re vwo mu imitete na ve eya wen ji mu ose wen ru wo rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Wọ davwerhọ rẹ eyere wẹ-ẹn, kidie otọ esiri rẹ Ijipt na ejobi ewẹn.
verses.text_romanized: wo davwerho re eyere we en kidie oto esiri re ijipt na ejobi ewen

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ rẹ Izrẹl de ghine ru ọtiọye; Josẹf da vwẹ akpẹrẹ kẹ ayen, kirobo ri Fero tare, ọ da vwẹ emuọre ke ayen vwẹ oyan na.
verses.text_romanized: emo re izrel de ghine ru otioye josef da vwe akpere ke ayen kirobo ri fero tare o da vwe emuore ke ayen vwe oyan na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da vwẹ ewun rẹ orẹ kẹ ayen ọvuọvo, ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da vwẹ uchunu rẹ idọnọ uri gbẹ ujori ki Bẹnjamin kugbe iwun rẹ orẹ iyori.
verses.text_romanized: o da vwe ewun re ore ke ayen ovuovo ekevuovo o da vwe uchunu re idono uri gbe ujori ki benjamin kugbe iwun re ore iyori

verses.text_urhobo: Ekuakua nana keye o vwo rhe ọsẹ rọye: oghwa rẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ ihwe re vọnre vẹ emu esiri rẹ Ijipt ejobi, oghwa rẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ eya ihwe rẹ ọkọka, ikara, kugbe emuọre rẹ oyan na kẹ ọsẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ekuakua nana keye o vwo rhe ose roye oghwa re eketekete ihwe re vonre ve emu esiri re ijipt ejobi oghwa re eketekete re eya ihwe re okoka ikara kugbe emuore re oyan na ke ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: O de siobọ nẹ emesẹ rọye yanran, rẹ ayen vwo kpo re, ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Wa ghwọ vwẹ idjerhe rẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o de siobo ne emese roye yanran re ayen vwo kpo re o da ta ke ayen wa ghwo vwe idjerhe re

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen de vrẹn nẹ Ijipt, ayen de rhi te otọ ri Kenan re vwa Jekọp rẹ ọsẹ rayen.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen de vren ne ijipt ayen de rhi te oto ri kenan re vwa jekop re ose rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da vuẹ, ni Josẹf je akpọ, kọye osun vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt. Oma de ro, kidie o se ayen gbuyota-a.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da vue ni josef je akpo koye osun vwe oto re ijipt oma de ro kidie o se ayen gbuyota a

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọke rẹ ayen vwo gbe ikun ri Josẹf ejobi vwọ kẹ, eta rọ ta kẹ ayen, kugbe ọke rọ vwọ mrẹ akpẹrẹ ri Josẹf vwo rhe ne vwo muo rhe, udu ri Jekọp da rhe sasa;
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oke re ayen vwo gbe ikun ri josef ejobi vwo ke eta ro ta ke ayen kugbe oke ro vwo mre akpere ri josef vwo rhe ne vwo muo rhe udu ri jekop da rhe sasa

verses.text_urhobo: Izrẹl da ta, O teri; Josẹf rẹ ọmọ mẹ je akpọ, Me yanran re Me ra mrẹ tavwe mi ki ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: izrel da ta o teri josef re omo me je akpo me yanran re me ra mre tavwe mi ki ghwu

headings.text_urhobo: Josẹf vwẹ oma Rọye Phia kẹ Iniọvo Rọye Vughe
headings.text_romanized: josef vwe oma roye phia ke iniovo roye vughe
